dashboard.title: Governed frontend delivery task console
dashboard.description: VisualEngineer serves enterprise frontend teams. Register tasks, explicitly start Level 0 committed-HEAD investigations, and review deterministic Plans without executing or modifying target code.
dashboard.createDescription: Every submission uses an independent idempotency key so a network replay cannot create a duplicate task.
dashboard.emptyDescription: Use the form above to create the first Foundation task.

repositoryConsole.title: Repository Intelligence
repositoryConsole.description: The Control Plane stores only an opaque handle, version, and bounded status. The host path remains in local Runner configuration and is never accepted or returned by this page.

repositoryConsole.emptyDescription: A Runner with the read-only fixture mount registers one automatically.

runnerConsole.title: Local Runner console
runnerConsole.description: Dispatch repository-independent typed diagnostics and cancellable waits from the browser. Runner has no project code, Shell, worktree, Git, or public-network authority.
runnerConsole.loadFailed: Runner control plane could not be loaded
runnerConsole.emptyRunnersHelp: After make platform-up runs, the local Runner registers automatically.
runnerConsole.systemDiagnosticHelp: Returns only redacted software, Python, OS family, architecture, and capability versions.
runnerConsole.controlledWaitHelp: Waits up to 10 seconds to verify leases, progress, and cancellation.
runnerConsole.noOnlineRunner: Dispatch is disabled because no Runner is Online.
runnerConsole.emptyJobsHelp: Use Dispatch to create the first bounded Job.

executionGrants.boundary: Plan Approval does not authorize execution. An Execution Grant is a separate human decision.
executionGrants.description: The server narrows policy from the approved Plan and current Repository Handle. The browser cannot submit Shell, host paths, or broader authority.

workspaces.title: Isolated Workspaces
workspaces.description: All changes occur only in a detached worktree inside the Runner volume. The Control Plane does not store an absolute path, and the source repository remains read-only.
workspaces.noGrantBefore: No approved Execution Grant is available. Complete an independent decision in

workspaces.ownershipMissing: Ownership proof is missing. Automatic discard is blocked; inspect recovery evidence without deleting this Workspace.

runConsole.title: Governed Repository Investigation
runConsole.description: The Snapshot extracts bounded structured facts from committed Git objects only. Dirty and untracked contents are not read, and repository scripts are not executed.
runConsole.emptyIntelligenceHelp: Creating a Snapshot reads committed HEAD from an allowlisted Git repository and does not read uncommitted file contents.

reviews.title: Review & Release Readiness
reviews.description: Package the exact Evidence chain from the latest successful Validation Suite into an immutable Review Package, complete a human Review Decision, then compute Release Readiness deterministically.
reviews.boundary: Review Approval is a governance decision only. It grants no commit, push, PR, merge, tag, deployment, or Delivery Authorization. Ready becomes invalid immediately when the baseline or Evidence becomes stale.
reviews.loading: Validating Suite Evidence and Review freshness…
reviews.createHelp: Only latest successful Suite Results not yet packaged are listed. A Package does not copy raw output; it stores an ordered identity/digest Evidence Manifest.
reviews.noCandidates: No successful Suite Result is awaiting packaging.
reviews.authorityBoundary: Git authorization: false · Deployment authorization: false · Delivery Authorization: not issued

delivery.title: Local Delivery Lifecycle
delivery.description: Bind a fresh, approved, ready Review baseline to a separate human Delivery Authorization. Before dispatch, inspect the immutable manifest and confirm its exact digest. Failed or cancelled delivery can retry only the same manifest.
delivery.boundary: Delivery Authorization never includes source-repository write, remote, push, PR, tag, or deploy authority. Review Approval cannot trigger delivery.
delivery.loading: Checking Review freshness and local-only authority boundaries…
delivery.createHelp: A candidate must remain the exact fresh Review generation with an approved decision and ready verdict. Authorization fixes the Checkpoint, diff hash, branch ref, and commit message.
delivery.noCandidates: No new fresh, approved, ready Review candidate is available.
delivery.diffSummary: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {bytes} bytes
delivery.localBoundary: Local ref only · source write, remote, push, PR, tag, and deploy remain denied.
delivery.confirmDigest: I confirm this exact manifest digest for local-only delivery.
delivery.sourceUnchanged: Source repository unchanged; no remote operation was performed.

validation.title: Validation Runs
validation.description: Run a system-owned, non-parameterizable, multi-step Validation Suite serially against an exact Workspace Checkpoint. Every real step has an independent Runner Attempt, Lease, and Evidence record.
validation.boundary: This page accepts no command, argv, cwd, environment variable, dependency install, or Provider configuration. Network and Shell remain disabled.
validation.requestGrantHelp: Only a Checkpoint that exactly matches the current Workspace tree fingerprint can be selected. The Execution Grant must be approved explicitly before Validation can run.
validation.noCheckpoint: No exact Checkpoint is currently eligible. Create a status, diff, or write Checkpoint in the Workspace first.
